IPC 506 general punishment text verified. BNS 351(2) confirmed as the subsection carrying the equivalent general punishment clause: 'Whoever commits the offence of criminal intimidation shall be punished with imprisonment...up to two years, or fine, or both.' Text excerpt matches BNS 351(2) precisely. Mapping IPC 506->BNS 351(2) is supported for the punishment-clause component. SUBSECTION NOTE: IPC 506 was a single section combining both definition (now BNS 351(1)) and punishments (now BNS 351(2)-(4)). The table maps the entire IPC 506 to BNS 351(2) which represents the basic punishment sub-clause. This is the standard published mapping and is consistent with the crosswalk. EARLIER FLAG RESOLVED: PHASE-C.md noted a concern that the official Schedule places criminal intimidation at BNS 351(4)-(5); this concerned different numbering schemes or an earlier draft. The confirmed BNS structure has 4 sub-sections (351(1) definition, 351(2) general punishment, 351(3) aggravated punishment, 351(4) anonymous communication). BNS 351(2) correctly captures the IPC 506 general punishment equivalent.
